purpose: One descent STRATEGY per axis: the fork mechanism that improves a capability along that axis, what it BINDS to, the existing machinery it REUSES, what GOVERNS it, and how it is MEASURED. The generic descender (src/teleon/evolution/descender.py) builds a fork + DistillationRecord from these entries, so adding a descent axis is a registry entry, not new code. determinism/cost/latency/llm_usage are handled by the distiller's distill() strategies and freshness by distill_robustness(); the entries below are the trust/robustness/openness axes the generic descender produces. Data only — never a src.baltor symbol; a fork is a candidate, never truth.

strategies.binds: source_handles + a lineage receipt on every output
strategies.reuses: the governance receipt/lineage rail (Baltor's core moat)
strategies.governed_by: promotion gate — a candidate without a receipt never becomes tenant-visible
strategies.measurement: fraction of outputs carrying verified source handles + a receipt
strategies.note: the Baltor thesis as a descent axis: agents PROPOSE, the receipt rail makes it PROVABLE.

strategies.binds: a machine-checkable proof (Lean / SMT / Z3) that the answer satisfies the domain's formalized rules; returns the proof OR the violated rule, never an unproven answer
strategies.reuses: the deterministic-rule layer + the verification foundry; COMPOSES with the freshness axis (re-prove when the source/spec changes) + source-authority (prove which spec is the authoritative one)
strategies.governed_by: won't return unless proved; the formal spec is itself version-pinned + freshness-synced so a stale spec is held out
strategies.measurement: fraction of answers with a machine-checkable proof; proof-coverage of the formalizable rule set
strategies.note: the Pramaana/AlphaProof formal-verification approach as ONE verifiability strategy for FORMALIZABLE domains — strictly broader for us: freshness keeps the proven spec CURRENT and source-authority proves the spec is authoritative, closing the bounded limitation formal-proof systems openly admit (a proof is only valid w.r.t. its encoded spec).

strategies.binds: an ENDPOINT SET (primary + ordered fallbacks) for one capability
strategies.reuses: src/teleon/endpoints (the alternative providers ARE the failover set)
strategies.governed_by: org policy filters which providers are eligible before the failover order is built
strategies.measurement: number of independent eligible providers (redundancy degree); observed success rate
strategies.note: single fragile provider -> survives any one provider going down.

strategies.reuses: the air-gapped-local-llm org policy + the local inference lanes (Ollama)
strategies.governed_by: the air-gapped org policy forbids cloud lanes; this fork satisfies it
strategies.note: data-sovereignty / air-gap: the capability runs entirely on-prem.

strategies.binds: a narrow small model / LoRA tuned to this capability's scope
strategies.reuses: src/teleon/training (the distillation_policy_lora artifact) + the model lanes
strategies.governed_by: eval-before-active (the small model must clear the capability's benchmark)
strategies.measurement: model size / scope-narrowness; co-improves cost + latency (small model is cheaper + faster)
strategies.note: general frontier model -> a narrow specialist (the small-models-need-narrow-scope thesis).

strategies.binds: a redaction/tokenization/synthetic step around the capability
strategies.reuses: the PII/review-gate flags already carried on candidates
strategies.governed_by: tenant-private lineage never becomes global; PII rows route to a review queue
strategies.note: PII-exposing -> the model/tool never sees raw PII.

strategies.governed_by: a versioned, replayable run is the audit unit
strategies.measurement: same input + pinned version -> same output (replay-hash match)
strategies.note: distinct from determinism: reproducible ACROSS time/versions, not just within one run.

strategies.binds: open-format I/O (OKF / open schemas) instead of a vendor-locked shape
strategies.note: ride above platforms on portable formats (the openness thesis).

strategies.reuses: src/teleon/self_healing (reheal + benchmark_health) — broader than freshness (any break)
strategies.governed_by: a heal counts only if it re-passes the whole benchmark; rollback target preserved
strategies.measurement: mean-time-to-recover; benchmark pass-rate after a break
strategies.note: brittle -> auto-recovers from ANY break, not only a source change.

strategies.binds: a low-energy runtime (local CPU, small model, cached, batch)
strategies.reuses: the execution-backend selector + the CPU-batch lane
strategies.governed_by: policy may require a carbon/energy ceiling
strategies.measurement: relative energy per call (kWh); co-improves cost

strategies.binds: a least-privilege sandbox + a deny-by-default capability boundary
strategies.reuses: the org guardrail policy + the forbidden-capabilities boundary + the sandbox provider
strategies.governed_by: deny-by-default; an open-ended runner is hard-guarded off generic functions
strategies.measurement: least-privilege score; granted vs available permissions 0..1
